## Problem and change

Explain the problem, why the change is needed, and how it helps users. Link related issues.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. For bug fixes, include a regression test.
For code changes, include correctness checks and before-and-after results for both benchmark
suites, with hardware and settings. Documentation-only changes do not need benchmarks.

## User impact

Note any API or behaviour changes and the documentation or examples updated, or write “None”.

See [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/hyperdimensionalcomputingai/lance-csr/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
